commands_used: answer 1. I woke in the hold of a barge with strangers, at Ashgate Landing. The door is locked. I do not know who I work for or why I am here. 2. Speak to Okeeh, the Argonian cook, in the hold. 3. I can talk to Okeeh, or to Hara-Jeel or Dralin Uveran; the door is locked and I have a lockpick. 4. answer 1. I am in the hold of an Owing barge at Ashgate Landing in Black Marsh; the gang serves months of reed-cutting work instead of a cell. The door stays locked until gang-master Dralin Uveran takes our names. 2. Tell Okeeh my trade, and enter my name when the game asks. 3. Seven trade topics: she mentioned fighter, hunter, thief, poultice-maker; I will see the list. 4. I do not understand the Owing in detail, what a Hist is, or Jal-Veesa; Okeeh has topics on them I can ask about.

answer 1. I told Okeeh I was a thief; my skills rose and the hold door was unbarred. I serve an Owing term cutting reed under gang-master Dralin Uveran. 2. Go out through the door onto the landing at Ashgate Landing. 3. Go out the door, or ask Okeeh more first. 4. Still unclear: what a Hist is, Jal-Veesa, and the details of the Owing; Okeeh has topics on them.

answer 1. My name was struck from the gang-master Dralin Uveran roll on an order from Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe no months. I do not know why she wants me. 2. Go east up the road to Vosh-Leera house in Jal-Veesa; on the way the tree-minder wants Sithis beard moss from below Reed-Sill Weir. 3. Go straight to Jal-Veesa, or gather the moss on the way; beware the crocodiles. 4. I do not know why Vosh-Leera wants me, what the Hist is, or what Sithis beard is for; I could ask in Jal-Veesa.

answer I am Tarin, a self-declared thief, with a lockpick. I woke on an Owing barge at Ashgate Landing in Black Marsh. Okeeh the cook helped; Dralin Uveran the Dunmer gang-master told me my name was struck from his roll on an order from Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe no months. She wants me at her house in Jal-Veesa, east up the road; I do not know why. On the way, the town tree-minder wants Sithis beard (grey moss) from the creek below Reed-Sill Weir, where there are crocodiles. I did not ask Okeeh about the Hist, Jal-Veesa or the Owing, so those are still unknown to me.
